title: Keep failed test-run continuation Retry visible during unrelated refresh
outcome: A failed continuation retains its Retry and remaining explicit page budget when another page refreshes; history stays user-controlled and errors never trigger an automatic retry loop.
acceptance: An unrelated first/visible-page refresh does not clear the failure for a different continuation or silently lose its retained explicit page budget.
A controlled failure followed by invalidation leaves Retry available until that continuation succeeds or the panel identity changes, with no automatic failure retry.
